findings.summary: MangaCard reactivity lost in unwrapped call sites
findings.detail: Removing MangaCard's internal ListenableBuilder.merge([favorites, history, feed]) drops live badge reactivity in the three screens that use MangaCard without a wrapping data listener: explore_screen ('Saran Bacaan'), source_catalog_screen (catalog grid), and manga_details_screen ('Komik Serupa'). First-build badge values are still correct (the card falls back to a LocalStorage query in build), but the badges go stale after build when the underlying boxes change (e.g. favoriting from a detail page no longer lights the heart on the explore card until that screen rebuilds; a background feed check no longer surfaces a new unread badge there). source_view_screen is unaffected because it wraps its whole build in merge([favorites, history, feed]); history and favorites are unaffected because they pre-compute badges in their itemBuilders under a still-wrapping listener (modulo the sanctioned P1 feed-listener removal).
findings.action: Wrap the MangaCard lists in explore_screen, source_catalog_screen, and manga_details_screen in a ListenableBuilder(Listenable.merge([LocalStorage.listenFavorites(), LocalStorage.listenHistory(), LocalStorage.listenFeed()])) matching source_view_screen's existing pattern, so the cards regain live updates without reintroducing per-card subscriptions. Alternatively, consciously accept the staleness for these discovery surfaces and document it.

findings.summary: Compact favorites itemExtent may clip at large font scale
findings.detail: favorites_screen compact ListView now uses itemExtent: 56.0. At normal font scale this exactly matches the item's natural height (44px cover + 12px vertical padding). At large accessibility font scales the one-line title/subtitle rows can outgrow the 44px cover and be clipped, whereas the old auto-sizing list would have simply grown the row.
findings.action: Verify with system font scale at ~1.5–2x. If clipping shows, raise the extent, switch to prototypeItem, or drop itemExtent for that case.
